    rs=[r for r,c in L]; cs=[c for r,c in L]; bb=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    others=[cells for v,cells in oo if cells!=L and len(cells)>1]
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for cells in others: groups[norm_shape(cells)].append(cells)
